chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Spain against Croatia, Euro 2024. Lamine Yamal turns into the box and pulls defenders toward him. He finds Pedri. Nice and calm, Pedri finds Fabián Ruiz. Right, left... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Croatia players close in, but Pedri stays calm. He knows Fabián is free, so one gentle pass is enough.

chapters.label: Right, left, goal
chapters.text: Fabián cuts right, then left, past two defenders, and his shot flies into the corner.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: like Pedri, check over your shoulder before the ball comes, so you know where to pass.
